legends-empire.purpose: Markdown knowledge foundation. For vault cleanup and project or session review, invoke the named vault stewardship capability (legends-vault-stewardship), included in the same Empire installation. Agents name the selected workflow before checking readiness and performing work. Optional Home-ready shared-root structure supports standalone Empire projects and an independently authorized AI Marketing Hub Home headless capability layer without duplicate business records.
legends-empire.scope: Python 3.11+ standard-library core. Reviewed transactions and knowledge attachment support native Windows on local fixed NTFS, plus macOS/Linux/POSIX. Windows fails closed on reparse paths, network shares and non-NTFS volumes. Windows process-crash recovery does not claim POSIX directory-fsync power-loss equivalence. Bash utilities remain POSIX-only; WSL DrvFS needs metadata. Obsidian Desktop is optional.

examples: Save this research in my vault
Find what we already know about this business
Clean and organize my vault with vault stewardship
Invoke legends-vault-stewardship
Review neglected projects and their next actions
Help me resume unfinished work from session handoffs
Attach the stewardship knowledge library to my Empire
Verify saved research evidence and plan its intake into this client vault
Slot my authorized AI Marketing Hub Home workspace into Empire
Check Home adapter compatibility without moving business records
Prepare a Home-ready Empire without installing Home
Add my authorized Home capability layer to the shared Empire root
discovery.not_for: Inventing sources, treating orphaned notes as disposable, controlling live agent sessions, or modifying a vault without selecting it. Native Windows transactions do not support network/UNC shares, reparse paths or non-NTFS volumes, and do not promise POSIX-equivalent power-loss durability. Bash utilities require POSIX. Does not grant private Home repository access, redistribute Home, activate Obsidian plugins, or automatically migrate business records.
discovery.setup: Select a vault. For vault stewardship, follow the installed recipe and run cto-legends run legends-vault-stewardship -- steward doctor. Research-export readiness applies only to research-export tasks. Native Windows transactions and knowledge attachment require Empire 0.3.1+, Python 3.11+, local fixed NTFS and supported current-user ACL ownership/security state; readiness fails closed for unsupported paths or security conditions. Review and apply in the same environment. macOS/Linux use POSIX filesystem semantics; WSL DrvFS needs metadata. Bash utilities remain POSIX-only. For optional Home-ready shared-root work, read docs/home-adapter.md. Preparation and original scaffolds work without Home. Adding the headless capability layer requires independently authorized pinned local Home source and explicit reviewed install, compose, and shared-root binding plans. Native Home validation has separate interpreter/dependency requirements. Home is not required for ordinary Empire installation, doctor, or vault workflows.
